parameters.query:
SELECT s.id AS shopkeeper_id, s.shop_name, s.owner_name, s.address, s.distributor_id,
  d.distributor_name, d.whatsapp_number AS distributor_whatsapp,
  ws.state, ws.cart, ws.last_message_id, ws.current_product_id
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS phone) x
LEFT JOIN shopkeepers s ON s.whatsapp_number = x.phone AND s.status = 'active'
LEFT JOIN distributors d ON d.id = s.distributor_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT state, cart, last_message_id, current_product_id FROM whatsapp_sessions w WHERE w.shopkeeper_id = s.id ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) ws ON true
LIMIT 1;

WITH sk AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS id),
priced AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.category, p.unit, p.description, p.image_url,
         COALESCE(sp.price, p.default_price) AS price
  FROM products p
  CROSS JOIN sk
  LEFT JOIN shopkeeper_prices sp ON sp.product_id = p.id AND sp.shopkeeper_id = sk.id
  WHERE p.active AND sk.id IS NOT NULL
),
f AS (
  SELECT * FROM priced
  WHERE $7::boolean
    AND ($2::text = '' OR category = $2::text)
    AND ($3::text = '' OR product_name ILIKE '%' || $3::text || '%' OR product_code ILIKE '%' || $3::text || '%'
         OR category ILIKE '%' || $3::text || '%' OR description ILIKE '%' || $3::text || '%')
),
lim AS (
  SELECT LEAST(GREATEST($4::int, 1), 10) AS l, (SELECT count(*) FROM f)::int AS n
),
off AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(LEAST(GREATEST($5::int, 0), ((n - 1) / l) * l), 0) AS o FROM lim
)
SELECT
  (SELECT n FROM lim) AS total,
  (SELECT o FROM off) AS page_offset,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(x) ORDER BY x.name, x.id), '[]'::json)
     FROM (SELECT id, product_name AS name, unit, price, description, category FROM f
           ORDER BY product_name, id LIMIT (SELECT l FROM lim) OFFSET (SELECT o FROM off)) x) AS products,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('name', category, 'count', n) ORDER BY category), '[]'::json)
     FROM (SELECT category, count(*)::int AS n FROM priced WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category <> '' GROUP BY category LIMIT 60) c) AS categories,
  (SELECT row_to_json(y)
     FROM (SELECT id, product_name AS name, product_code AS code, unit, price, description, category, image_url
           FROM priced WHERE id = NULLIF($6::text, '')::bigint) y) AS product;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE whatsapp_sessions
  SET state = $4, cart = $5::jsonb, phone_number = $3, distributor_id = $2::bigint,
      current_product_id = NULLIF($7::text, '')::bigint, last_message_id = $6, last_message_at = now(), expires_at = now() + interval '1 day', updated_at = now()
  WHERE shopkeeper_id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO whatsapp_sessions (shopkeeper_id, distributor_id, phone_number, state, cart, current_product_id, last_message_id, last_message_at, expires_at)
SELECT $1::bigint, $2::bigint, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, NULLIF($7::text, '')::bigint, $6, now(), now() + interval '1 day'
WHERE $1::bigint IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd);

WITH o AS (
  INSERT INTO orders (order_number, shopkeeper_id, distributor_id, status, total_amount, confirmed_at)
  VALUES ('ORD-' || to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYMMDD-HH24MISS') || '-' || $1::bigint, $1::bigint, $2::bigint, 'confirmed', $3::numeric, now())
  RETURNING id, order_number, total_amount
), items AS (
  INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price, line_total)
  SELECT o.id, (i->>'product_id')::bigint, i->>'name', (i->>'qty')::numeric, (i->>'unit_price')::numeric, (i->>'line_total')::numeric
  FROM o, jsonb_array_elements($4::jsonb) i
  RETURNING id
), sess AS (
  UPDATE whatsapp_sessions
  SET state = 'IDLE', cart = '[]'::jsonb, order_id = (SELECT id FROM o), last_message_id = $5, last_message_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE shopkeeper_id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_number, o.total_amount, (SELECT count(*) FROM items) AS item_count FROM o;
